body_md:
The test is taken on a computer at an approved test centre. You must book it in advance and bring the right identification.

There are **24 questions** and you have **45 minutes**. To pass you need **18 correct answers (75%)**. If you do not pass, you can take the test again, but you must pay each time.
key_facts: You can retake the test, but you pay each time
